findings.evidence: Studies show that about 70% of adults who keep to a six-month schedule avoid a major restoration over the foll
findings.message: Statistic or study claim with no source link in the paragraph.
'Best/top' claim with no verifiable basis in the ficha.
Carrier is not listed as accepted in the ficha.

findings.quote: We are in network with Delta Dental, Aetna and MetLife
findings.why: The ficha lists only Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife as accepted carriers, so naming Aetna and claiming network status are both unsupported.
findings.fix: Name only Delta Dental and MetLife (Cigna is also on file), and replace "in network" with "we accept" to match the ficha wording.

findings.why: "Top-rated" is a superlative with no supporting source, and the ficha lists no awards or ratings, so it is a "best" claim the ADA advertising rules do not allow.
findings.fix: Delete the superlative and state the factual description, for example "Our Austin team".

findings.quote: Studies show that about 70% of adults who keep to a six-month schedule avoid a major restoration over the following five years.
findings.why: This specific statistic has no citation or link, and I cannot verify that any such study exists, so it could mislead readers.
findings.fix: Remove the percentage, or cite a specific study with a working link that supports the exact figure, or rephrase to a general statement that six-month visits help catch problems early.

findings.quote: Ask five people how often they see the dentist and you will hear five answers.
findings.why: The rhetorical opener and the "it is not a rule" framing read as generic AI-written phrasing.
findings.fix: Open with a concrete, practice-specific sentence about how the team decides on a schedule.

findings.quote: Tartar builds up on a timeline that is similar for most people
findings.why: This is a general, harmless statement that lacks a source but is not a specific figure.
findings.fix: Add a link to an ADA or NIDCR page on plaque and tartar, or soften to "tartar builds up over time".
